title: The Old Wars: A First Blooding

texts.details:
You hit the post well. The post does not hit back, and the post has no brothers.

Before I teach you one thing more, I will know what you do when something is trying to kill you. The Razormane are in the hills west of here. Take six of their battleguards. One at a time if you can, and learn what happens when you cannot.

There is one among them the grunts call Gorethistle. He is bigger than the rest and he enjoys it. Bring him down, $N. Then we will speak of war.
texts.objectives: Kill 6 Razormane Battleguards and then Gorethistle, among the quilboar west of Razor Hill. Return to your trainer when it is done.
texts.progress: Keep your feet under you. A warrior on his back is meat.
texts.completion:
Gorethistle is dead? Good. And you stand. That is the first test and the only one that counts.

Now listen. Everything you will ever do with an axe was learned by someone, in one of the wars our people have fought on this world. The humans number them: First, Second, Third. We fought in every one, and not always on a side we are proud of. A warrior who does not know those wars is only an arm with iron in it.

So that is how you will be taught. One war at a time, by those who were there. Take one of these. When you have twenty seasons of sense, go to Thork at the Crossroads, in the Barrens. He will tell you of the first.

idea: The Old Wars, level 10 (Horde): the warrior's first real fight, against one the trainer names. Invented: Gorethistle.
